# Rules reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm gen:rules-page` from scripts/checks/generate-rules-page.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page lists every rule that at least one shipped preset or config turns on. It is generated from the rule manifest, the pinned `@effect/tsgo` policy, and the root oxlint engine. Regenerate it with `pnpm gen:rules-page`; `pnpm check` fails when it is stale. To search and filter the same list, run `pnpm rules:view`.

Severity reads `normal / tests` when test files differ, where tests means files that match the test-file overrides. The presets, configs, and compositions are:

- `generalPreset`
- `effectPreset`
- `effectReactPreset`
- `boundariesPreset`
- `effectTsgoConfig`
- `baseConfig`
- `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig`

The tsgo descriptions come from `@effect/tsgo` 0.46.1 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Effect).

## Package rules (44)

Rules this package implements. What it catches is the manifest note; the fix is the rule message.

| Rule | Presets and configs | Severity | What it catches | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-arrow-ladder` | `effectPreset` | error | An immediately invoked inline function whose body or parameters contain another immediately invoked inline function, such as nested arrow IIFEs, in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** bind intermediate values with const and keep one flat pipeline or Effect.gen. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-atom-registry-effect-sync` | `effectReactPreset` | error | An Effect-returning call to the v4 Atom module's get, set, update, modify, or refresh inside an inline Effect.sync callback, which builds an Effect that never runs; synchronous AtomRegistry instance methods are fine. **Fix:** yield* it from Effect code instead of wrapping it in Effect.sync. AtomRegistry instance methods stay synchronous. | Ref: effect reactivity Atom. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-barrel-import` | `effectPreset` | error | A runtime named or namespace import from the effect barrel, such as import { Effect } from 'effect'; type-only and subpath imports are fine. **Fix:** import the namespace subpath, such as import * as Effect from 'effect/Effect', including when copying reference snippets. Type-only imports are fine. | Ref: ADR-001. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-branch-in-object` | `effectPreset` | error | An Option.match or Match.value decision written inside an object literal. **Fix:** compute the value into a named const first, then build the object from named values. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-cross-package-relative-imports` | `boundariesPreset` | error | A relative import that crosses from one package under apps, examples, or packages into another. **Fix:** import the package by name through its package.json exports. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-discarded-failure` | `effectPreset` | error | An inline Effect.catch, catchCause, catchDefect, catchEager, mapError, match onFailure, or try catch handler that never reads its error, unless an earlier tapError, tapCause, or tapDefect in the same pipeline recorded the failure. **Fix:** name tags with Effect.catchTag/catchTags, pass the error as cause, or record it first with tapError or Effect.ignore({ log: true }). | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-double-cast` | `generalPreset`, `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | `generalPreset`: error<br>`baseConfig`: error / off<br>`baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig`: error / off | A cast through any or unknown, such as value as unknown as User, outside config and tooling files, unless a lint-allow-double-cast comment gives the reason. **Fix:** decode with Schema or narrow with a typed adapter, or put // lint-allow-double-cast: &lt;reason> on the line above. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-all-step-sequencing` | `effectPreset` | error | An Effect.all array used to run state-changing steps in order, such as Atom.set or Reactivity.invalidate calls with concurrency 1 or a discarded asVoid result. **Fix:** yield* each step in Effect.gen or chain them with Effect.andThen; keep Effect.all for combining values. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-bind` | `effectPreset` | error | Any call to Effect.bind, the builder-style do notation. **Fix:** write the steps in Effect.gen as const value = yield* step. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-call-in-effect-arg` | `effectPreset` | error | A data-first transforming call (map, flatMap, andThen, tap, flatten, catch*, or zip*) whose source argument is itself an Effect call, such as Effect.map(Effect.succeed(1), f); runners, forks, and resource helpers such as acquireRelease, scoped, and ensuring may take an Effect. **Fix:** pipe the source (source.pipe(Effect.map(f))) or use Effect.gen. Runners, forks, and resource helpers may take an Effect. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-escape-hatch` | `effectPreset` | error | Effect.die and Effect.orDie, called or passed as a value, outside test files. **Fix:** keep a typed error. For a truly unrecoverable invariant or entry config failure, add an inline disable that says why; oxlint overrides can exempt a file. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-internal-tags` | `effectPreset` | error | A _tag comparison against a v4 data tag of an imported Effect module: Option Some or None, Exit or Result Success or Failure, or a Cause reason's Fail, Die, or Interrupt. **Fix:** use the public helpers, such as Option.isSome, Exit.isFailure, Result.match, or Cause.isFailReason. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-ladder` | `effectPreset` | error | A const or returned data-first transforming call whose source nests further Effect calls, so the chain reads from the innermost call outward; it takes precedence over no-effect-call-in-effect-arg and no-flatmap-ladder. **Fix:** start from the innermost source and pipe each step, or use Effect.gen. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-effect-side-effect-wrapper` | `effectPreset` | error | A side-effect call in the value slot of Effect.as, which runs once when the Effect is built instead of when it runs; pure values and function values are fine. **Fix:** run the effect as a step with Effect.tap or yield* in Effect.gen. A pure value is fine. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-flatmap-ladder` | `effectPreset` | warn | A flatMap nested inside a flatMap callback, or flatten over map, in shapes the two error-level ladder rules do not already report. **Fix:** write the steps in Effect.gen with yield*, or pipe them one after another. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-fromnullable-nullish-coalesce` | `effectPreset` | error | Option.fromNullishOr(value ?? null) and Option.fromUndefinedOr(value ?? undefined), where the fallback is redundant or changes how null is treated; there is no autofix because dropping ?? undefined turns a null into Some(null). **Fix:** use Option.fromNullishOr(value); keep fromUndefinedOr(value) only if null is impossible or a real value. No autofix. | Ref: effect Option. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-iife-wrapper` | `effectPreset` | error | An inline function that is called immediately, in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** bind the value with const and keep one flat pipeline, Match, or Effect.gen. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-inline-schema-compile` | `effectPreset` | warn | A Schema decoder or encoder factory inside a function whose schema argument is built inline with a Schema constructor call, so each call rebuilds the schema and can miss the parser cache; decoding a hoisted schema is fine. **Fix:** hoist the schema to module scope, and optionally the decoder or encoder; decoding a hoisted schema inline is fine. | Ref: effect Schema. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-instanceof-error` | `effectPreset` | error | An instanceof Error check in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** model expected failures as tagged errors handled with Effect.catchTag or catchTags, and keep an unknown cause as a typed error's cause. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-instanceof-tagged-error` | `effectPreset` | error | An instanceof check against a class whose name ends in Error, other than Error itself, in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** recover with Effect.catchTag or catchTags, or branch with Match.tag. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-json-parse` | `effectPreset` | error | Any JSON.parse call in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** decode through Schema, such as Schema.decodeUnknownEffect(Schema.fromJsonString(MySchema)). | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-manual-tag-check` | `effectPreset` | error | A hand-written _tag comparison, such as error._tag === 'NotFound' or '_tag' in value; reading _tag without branching is fine, and the rule deliberately departs from effect-solutions, which compares reason tags by hand. **Fix:** use Effect.catchTag or catchTags for errors, Match.tag for values, and Effect.catchReason for nested reasons; reading _tag without branching is fine. | Ref: house style, not an Effect rule. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-match-effect-branch` | `effectPreset` | error | Effect or Stream work sequenced inside a Match.value pipeline branch or an Option.match callback, such as Effect.flatMap in a branch; returning a plain Effect.succeed is fine. **Fix:** select a value in the match, then run one Effect pipeline outside it, or move the logic into Effect.gen. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-model-overlay-cast` | `effectPreset` | error | A type assertion used as a const initializer, such as const user = data as User, in a file that imports Effect; as const is fine. **Fix:** decode with the matching Schema and read the typed fields; as const is fine. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-option-as` | `effectPreset` | error | Any call to Option.as. **Fix:** use Option.map or Option.match and return the value explicitly. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-option-boolean-normalization` | `effectPreset` | error | An Option.match whose onSome returns value === true and whose onNone returns false. **Fix:** decode the boolean once at the Schema boundary and read it directly. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-pipe-ladder` | `effectPreset` | error | An inline Effect.flatMap, andThen, or tap callback nested inside another Effect step or handler callback, reported once per outer callback. **Fix:** yield* each step in one Effect.gen or Effect.fn; one-step handler bodies and Effect.all items are fine. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-promise-catch` | `effectPreset` | error | A .catch(...) call in a file that imports Effect, other than Effect.catch. **Fix:** wrap the Promise with Effect.tryPromise and recover with Effect.catch, catchTag, or catchTags. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-promise-reject` | `effectPreset` | error | Promise.reject(...) and calls to a Promise executor's reject parameter, in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** fail with Effect.fail and a tagged error, or wrap Promise code with Effect.tryPromise. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-react-state` | `effectReactPreset` | error | The React hooks useEffect, useReducer, useContext, useCallback, and useSyncExternalStore, called bare or as members; useState stays allowed for state local to one component, and the rule cannot tell whether that state is shared. **Fix:** use atoms for shared or server state, ScopedAtom instead of context, and useState only for state local to one component. | Ref: house style, PA-3. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-redundant-error-factory` | `effectPreset` | error | A helper whose name ends in Error and that only returns a new tagged error, passing through no argument or its single argument. **Fix:** construct the tagged error directly, such as new MyError({ ... }). | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-redundant-primitive-cast` | `generalPreset`, `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | An as string, as number, or as boolean assertion on an identifier or member expression, outside config and tooling files. **Fix:** remove a redundant cast, or decode unknown data with Schema or a typed adapter first. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-render-side-effects` | `effectReactPreset` | error | A Match.value(...).pipe(...) with Match.when or Match.orElse steps used as a statement, so its branches run for their side effects during render. **Fix:** keep Match as a pure expression and move the side effect into an event handler or an Effect action. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-return-null` | `effectPreset` | warn | A return null inside an Effect.gen or Effect.fn generator, and Effect.succeed(null); React components and nullable boundary helpers are fine. **Fix:** return Option.none() or use Effect.succeedNone; use Option.fromNullishOr and Option.getOrNull at nullable interfaces. Effect can carry null; this is house style. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-string-error-channel` | `effectPreset` | error | Effect.fail with a string literal or plain template literal as its only argument. **Fix:** fail with a named tagged error, Data-tagged for internal errors or Schema-tagged for wire errors, so callers can use Effect.catchTag. No autofix: the class, tag, and fields are domain choices. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-switch-statement` | `effectPreset` | error | Any switch statement in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** use Match.value or Match.type, Option.match, or Result.match, then run one pipeline. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-try-catch` | `effectPreset` | error | A try statement with a catch clause in a file that imports Effect; try/finally is fine. **Fix:** wrap throwing code with Effect.try or Effect.tryPromise, and handle failures with typed errors and the Effect.catch combinators. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-ts-nocheck` | `generalPreset`, `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | A ts-nocheck directive anywhere in a file. **Fix:** fix the types, or use a narrow ts-expect-error comment with a reason. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-unknown-boolean-coercion-helper` | `effectPreset` | error | A typeof value === 'boolean' check in a file that also has a Match.orElse(() => null) fallback. **Fix:** decode the optional boolean at the Schema boundary and read the typed value. | Ref: linteffect. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/no-unknown-error-message` | `effectPreset` | error | Reading .message, calling String(), or destructuring message on a value caught by a catch clause or by an Effect.try or Effect.tryPromise catch handler, unless a guard on the same binding proves its shape first. **Fix:** keep it as a typed error's cause, or decode or narrow it into a validated binding. A cast does not make it safe. | Ref: house style. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/prefer-effect-fn` | `effectPreset` | error | A named function whose only job is to return Effect.gen; it overlaps effecttsgo/effect-fn-opportunity on purpose and, unlike it, reports without a TypeScript project (ADR-007). **Fix:** define it as Effect.fn("name")(function* (...) { ... }), or Effect.fnUntraced for hot paths. | Ref: ADR-001. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/prefer-effect-predicate` | `effectPreset` | error | A one-parameter function that only returns a nullish comparison of its parameter, whether declared, assigned to a variable, or passed to .filter, in a file that imports Effect. **Fix:** use Predicate.isNotNull, isNotUndefined, isNotNullish, isNull, isUndefined, or isNullish. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/prefer-schema-inferred-types` | `effectPreset` | error | An interface or object type alias named like a schema in the same file, such as type User beside UserSchema, instead of a type derived from that schema. **Fix:** derive the type from the schema, such as type User = typeof UserSchema.Type. | Ref: executor. |
| `@mplibunao/oxlint-standards/prevent-dynamic-imports` | `generalPreset`, `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | Any dynamic import() expression. **Fix:** use a static import; turn the rule off where code splitting is measured and intended. | Ref: linteffect, PA-4. |

Rules delegated to `@effect/tsgo`, which run only on the patched oxlint route. Descriptions are the upstream text; tsgo rules the policy sets off everywhere are not listed.

| Rule | Presets and configs | Severity | What it catches | Docs |

| `effecttsgo/acquire-release-disposable` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.acquireDisposable when Effect.acquireRelease only invokes the acquired resource's disposal protocol | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/acquire-release-disposable.md) |
| `effecttsgo/all-of-map-to-for-each` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.forEach instead of Effect.all over an effectful Array#map | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/all-of-map-to-for-each.md) |
| `effecttsgo/any-unknown-in-error-context` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Detects 'any' or 'unknown' types in Effect error or requirements channels | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/any-unknown-in-error-context.md) |
| `effecttsgo/async-function` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when declaring async functions and suggests using Effect values and Effect.gen for async control flow | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/async-function.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-all-tag-dispatch-to-catch-tag` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.catchTag or Effect.catchTags for catch-all handlers that re-fail unmatched tagged errors | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-all-tag-dispatch-to-catch-tag.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-all-to-map-error` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.mapError instead of Effect.catch + Effect.fail | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-all-to-map-error.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-chain-to-first-success-of` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.firstSuccessOf for consecutive error-independent Effect.catch fallbacks when the error type is preserved | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-chain-to-first-success-of.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-conditional-refail-to-catch-if` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.catchIf, Effect.catchCauseIf, or Effect.catchTag for conditional catch handlers that re-fail their untouched input | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-conditional-refail-to-catch-if.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-if-tag-to-catch-tag` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.catchTag instead of Effect.catchIf with a direct _tag equality predicate | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-if-tag-to-catch-tag.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-refail-to-tap-error` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.tapError for catch handlers that sequence an effect and then re-fail the original error | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-refail-to-tap-error.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-tag-to-catch-reason` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.catchReason or Effect.catchReasons for handlers that re-fail unmatched reason._tag branches | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-tag-to-catch-reason.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-to-ignore` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.ignore or Effect.ignoreCause instead of Effect.catch/catchCause returning Effect.void | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-to-ignore.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-to-or-else-succeed` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.orElseSucceed instead of Effect.catch + Effect.succeed | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-to-or-else-succeed.md) |
| `effecttsgo/catch-unfailable-effect` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when using error handling on Effects that never fail | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/catch-unfailable-effect.md) |
| `effecttsgo/class-self-mismatch` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Ensures Self type parameter matches the class name in Context/Service/Tag/Schema classes | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/class-self-mismatch.md) |
| `effecttsgo/crypto-random-uuid` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when using crypto.randomUUID() outside Effect generators instead of the Effect Crypto module | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/crypto-random-uuid.md) |
| `effecttsgo/crypto-random-uuid-in-effect` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Warns when using crypto.randomUUID() inside Effect generators instead of the Effect Crypto module | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/crypto-random-uuid-in-effect.md) |
| `effecttsgo/duplicate-package` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when multiple versions of an Effect-related package are detected in the program | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/duplicate-package.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-do-notation` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Suggests using Effect.gen or Effect.fn instead of the Effect.Do notation helpers | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-do-notation.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-fn-iife` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Effect.fn or Effect.fnUntraced is called as an IIFE; use Effect.gen instead | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-fn-iife.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-fn-implicit-any` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Mirrors noImplicitAny for unannotated Effect.fn, Effect.fnUntraced, and Effect.fnUntracedEager callback parameters when no outer contextual function type exists. Requires TS's noImplicitAny: true | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-fn-implicit-any.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-fn-opportunity` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Suggests using Effect.fn for functions that return an Effect | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-fn-opportunity.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-gen-uses-adapter` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when using the deprecated adapter parameter in Effect.gen | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-gen-uses-adapter.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-in-failure` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Warns when an Effect is used inside an Effect failure channel | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-in-failure.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-in-void-success` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | error | Detects nested Effects in void success channels that may cause unexecuted effects | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-in-void-success.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-map-flatten` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.flatMap instead of Effect.map followed by Effect.flatten in piping flows | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-map-flatten.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-map-void` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.asVoid instead of Effect.map(() => void 0), Effect.map(() => undefined), or Effect.map(() => {}) | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-map-void.md) |
| `effecttsgo/effect-succeed-with-void` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests using Effect.void instead of Effect.succeed(undefined) or Effect.succeed(void 0) | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/effect-succeed-with-void.md) |
| `effecttsgo/extends-native-error` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Warns when a class directly extends the native Error class | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/extends-native-error.md) |
| `effecttsgo/flat-map-conditional-to-filter-or-fail` | `effectPreset`, `effectTsgoConfig` | warn | Suggests Effect.filterOrFail or Effect.filterOrElse when Effect.flatMap conditionally passes its input through with Effect.succeed | [docs](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo/blob/@effect/tsgo@0.46.1/docs/rules/flat-map-conditional-to-filter-or-fail.md) |

## Built-in oxlint rules (253)

Built-in rules come from `oxlint --print-config` on `baseConfig` and on the base, Vitest, and Node runtime composition, plus the built-in rules a preset sets explicitly.

| Rule | Presets and configs | Severity | What it catches | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@typescript-eslint/array-type` | `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | Style rule enforced at error because it is autofixable, preserves consistency, reduces diff churn, and is fixed automatically by `vp check --fix`. | [docs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules/typescript/array-type.html) |
| `@typescript-eslint/await-thenable` | `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | Category: `correctness`. | [docs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules/typescript/await-thenable.html) |
| `@typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment` | `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | Suppressing TypeScript diagnostics is a type-safety escape hatch, not style. | [docs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules/typescript/ban-ts-comment.html) |
| `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-exports` | `baseConfig`, `baseConfig + vitestConfig + nodeRuntimeConfig` | error | Type-only exports must stay explicit so runtime exports are reviewable. | [docs](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules/typescript/consistent-type-exports.html) |
